process_type: Official IDAES subcritical coal-fired full power plant with expanded boiler, waterwall, steam-cycle, feedwater-heater, turbine, and cross-flowsheet PFD topology
source_basis: Source flowchart evidence unavailable: no --source-flowchart was provided.
The official IDAES documentation describes the steady-state subcritical power plant built by subcritical_power_plant.main_steady_state().
The source creates m.fs_main.fs_blr and m.fs_main.fs_stc, then their internal set_arcs_and_constraints() functions connect the PFD-level units.
The official boiler source connects economizer, drum, downcomer, Waterwalls[1..12], roof, primary superheater, attemperator, platen, reheaters, air preheater, and flue-gas path arcs.
The official steam-cycle source connects the turbine, condensers, hotwell, pumps, valves, feedwater heaters, deaerator, spray split, and BFP turbine arcs.
The official full-plant source connects S001 main steam, S005 cold reheat, S009 hot reheat, S042 feedwater to economizer, and B006 attemperator spray water arcs.
